title: One-click SKU mapping + legal smoke test (marketplace fasttrack mini-runbook)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact runbook for a "one-click" SKU mapping flow and an accompanying legal/compliance smoke test for accelerated marketplace onboarding. Target audience: partner success, seller ops, legal intake, and partner engineering. Use when we want to publish a tight trial SKU quickly with minimal manual gating.

Summary:
- Goal: enable a partner listing with a single SKU mapping operation that can be validated via a short smoke test to unblock fast listing or pilot launches.
- Scope: AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace entries; trial entitlement only (no complex metering or custom contracts).
- Outcome: checklist + tile copy snippets + preflight tests + rollback triggers.

Who should run this:
- Partner PM / Solutions Engineer: owns mapping decisions and validation
- Partner Legal reviewer: approves terms language and data residency note
- Marketplace Ops: perform the actual portal publish
- Billing owner: confirm SKU mapping and trial provisioning

Preflight gating (must pass all):
1) SKU mapping verified
   - Mapped SKU exists in vendor portal and points to a trial entitlement.
   - Backend entitlement test user can successfully request trial tokens (API smoke call).
2) Legal language check
   - Short license snippet on listing matches approved OEM terms template (verifier: Legal).
   - No unsupported compliance claims (e.g., HIPAA-ready) unless vendor attested.
3) Data residency & KMS note
   - If partner marks data residency, ensure VPC/private deployment compatibility note included.
4) Security telemetry
   - Listing includes contact for security incidents and SOC2/HIPAA status if requested.
5) Billing & metering
   - Trial SKU should be set to 0-cost for trial period; post-trial billing flow documented.

Tile copy snippets (short variants for partner portal):
- Headline (11–14 chars): "Low-latency LLM inference"
- Short line (28–40 chars): "Run open models cost-effectively at scale"
- 1-sentence blurb (80–120 chars): "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, production-grade LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — try a free trial with automatic scale and usage analytics."
- CTA options: "Start free trial", "Try with free credits", "Launch sandbox"
- Compliance footnote (16–40 chars): "Enterprise-ready: SOC2, VPC & KMS"

Trial UX flow (happy path):
1) Customer clicks "Start free trial" on marketplace tile.
2) Marketplace provisions trial SKU and calls Redwood provisioning webhook.
3) Redwood creates trial tenant, seeds credits, and returns success payload.
4) Customer receives email with quickstart link and one-line cURL to call API.
5) First API call returns a short sample response within SLO (smoke latency test).
6) Telemetry pipeline logs token usage; billing entry surfaced in partner portal.

Quick API smoke commands (for integration test):
- Generate: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer TRIAL_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Hello"}'
- Expected: 200 OK with keys: id, model, output[0].text; latency < 500ms for small model on trial infra.

Acceptance criteria for go-live:
- Tile copy approved by marketing & legal
- Backend webhook success rate > 98% during test window
- Billing mapping validated with one end-to-end sample invoice line
- Trial activation email templated and validated

Smoke-test checklist (run during preflight window):
- [ ] Provision trial SKU in vendor portal
- [ ] Trigger provisioning webhook and confirm 200/ACK
- [ ] Login to tenant as trial admin
- [ ] Run generate smoke API and observe output
- [ ] Confirm telemetry event with correct partner ID
- [ ] Confirm trial expiration countdown visible in console
- [ ] Legal snippet present on tile and in product FAQ
- [ ] Security contact and compliance badges present

Rollback triggers (if any fail):
- If provisioning webhook fails > 5% in 30m -> pause publishing
- If generate latency > 2s in 3 consecutive runs -> disable trial SKU
- If billing mapping results in non-zero charge in trial -> immediate rollback and incident

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to represent customizations (e.g., private deployment toggles) in a one-click flow? suggested: add an "advanced options" modal on the portal tile.
- Add localization variants for APAC partners (owner: Localization team)
- Define SLO thresholds per region for trial infra vs production infra (inputs needed from SRE)

Decision log (mini):
- 2024-11-08: Decided to limit fasttrack to trial-only SKUs to reduce billing risk.
- 2024-11-20: Legal approved condensed terms; agreed to include a link to full TOS rather than embed.

Appendix: quick links & refs
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-7291 (marketplace fasttrack design)
- Jira epic: JIRA-2314 (onramp automation)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-listing/pull/58

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep copy punchy, avoid overpromising model coverage. emphasize hosting modes + SLAs.
- Partner engineering wants an automated test harness — could be a 1-click "run smoke test" button in the portal.
- Pick a single canonical trial token TTL (recommend 14 days) and document.

Next steps (owners):
- Partner PM (Ethan Park): finalize tile copy by 2024-11-15
- Legal (Sofia R. Mendes): sign off on snippet by 2024-11-22
- Marketplace Ops (Liam O'Connor): schedule publish window and run preflight

Status: in_review
